```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

get_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {

  response <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  page <- resp_body_html(response)

  imdb_table <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table()

  tooltips <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  tibble(
    rank_title = imdb_table[[1]],
    rating = imdb_table[[2]],
    tooltip = tooltips
  ) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title,
      patterns = c(
        rank = "\\d+",
        "\\.\\s+",
        title = ".*",
        "\\s+\\(",
        year = "\\d{4}",
        "\\)"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      rank = as.integer(rank),
      year = as.integer(year),
      rating = readr::parse_number(as.character(rating)),
      number = readr::parse_number(
        stringr::str_extract(tooltip, "[\\d,]+(?= votes)")
      )
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2_dfr(
  snapshot_urls,
  snapshot_years,
  get_imdb_snapshot
)
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(
    rank_2015 = as.numeric(rank_2015),
    rank_2022 = as.numeric(rank_2022),
    rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rank_changes
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank, year) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(
    rank_2015 = as.numeric(rank_2015),
    rank_2022 = as.numeric(rank_2022),
    rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022),
    release_decade = (year %/% 10) * 10
  )

rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(
    average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)
  ) |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
film_appearances <- imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count")

film_appearances |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "number_of_films") |>
  arrange(snapshot_count)
```
